input.question: Why is it that I hear about people in the past dying of the common cold while I'm able to beat the common cold with no medication and/or major symptoms?
input.ground_truth: You probably have a balanced diet and aren't missing any nutrients. You also probably have a warm home and don't work in the fields every day. Bottom line, our lives are less stressful and we have better food than our ancestors.

But now, we know a lot more about colds. We have things like warm blankets, soup, and medicine that can help us feel better. Also, our bodies are used to seeing colds, so they can fight them off more easily. That’s why you can get a cold and just feel a little bit icky, but you get better without being super sick.

So, people in the past got really sick from colds because they didn’t have the same help we have now. But you have better ways to help your body fight the cold!
